title: Tech Note: The 4D Business Kit IP Component

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued for many years, making the specific IP Component extensibility mechanism obsolete; any modern e-commerce solution built with 4D today would use current web/ORDA/REST tooling rather than this legacy closed-source-with-plugin-extension architecture.
